name: liquid-glass-sidebar-menu
title: Liquid Glass Sidebar
description: A narrow rounded sidebar of five icon-and-label rows — Dashboard, Search, Sales Analytics, Notification and Account Settings — on a smoky glass panel over a photo, with the active row as a white pill.
use: You want a floating app menu that keeps the background photo visible behind it.
avoid: It is a fixed 280px panel with hardcoded destinations and no collapse, so it cannot shrink on phones.
a11y: Buttons are keyboard reachable but have no visible focus ring, and dragging is pointer-only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall dark rounded panel, about 280px wide, sits over a photo of mossy stone and water. Five full-width rows each pair a small line icon with a label; the top row is a white pill with dark text, the rest are white text on near-black glass. A soft edge highlight outlines the panel.
behaves: The panel can be grabbed and dragged as a whole, springing back toward its start when released. Menu rows lighten to a translucent white wash on hover, and the current Dashboard row stays a filled white pill.
customise: Menu labels, icons and destinations are written into the JSX; blur, shadow, glow, radius and the draggable flag come from the card props. The 280px width is set by a class.
weight: moderate: One blurred glass panel with a displacement filter and five simple buttons.
